bullets.text: JPM expects no meaningful China property stimulus before National Day and forecasts 20-30% y/y sales decline next year.

detail.summary: The sector rallied on talk of nationwide mortgage subsidies before 1 October. JPM's base case is no needle-moving stimulus: local subsidies are capped (Shanghai Rmb50K per unit) and tier-1 prices are stabilising. Hedge funds are selling strength. This is relevant to China steel and aluminium demand.
